strongest_angle: Analyze the November 2026 court filings where Prince Harry, Sir Elton John, and Elizabeth Hurley petitioned the High Court for permission to challenge a massive privacy ruling and joint legal costs of up to £34.5 million owed to Associated Newspapers.

key_facts.fact: Prince Harry and five other claimants applied for permission to appeal against the dismissal of their privacy case against Associated Newspapers and an indemnity costs order on November 6, 2026.
In August 2026, the judge ordered the claimants to make an initial costs payment of £9.54 million while the final total was calculated, facing joint legal costs of up to £34.5 million.
Sir Elton John and actress Elizabeth Hurley are among the high-profile claimants challenging the High Court judgment delivered by Mr Justice Nicklin.
